recent_articles.title: Power, blood, glory: Sumit Antil’s arduous road to world record number 10
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sumit Antil**, reigning world para champion, achieved a new world record of 74.82m in the men's javelin throw F64 final at the eighth Indian Open International Para Athletics Championships in Bengaluru last week. After a three-year period without breaking his own world mark, Antil attributed this success to rediscovering his old rhythm and focusing on speed and power during training under coach **Vipin Kasana**.  Antil's latest achievement follows a string of successful competitions including the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Games, where he defended his Paralympic title with a record throw, and the 2024 World Para Athletics Championships in Kobe. He aims to continue this momentum at upcoming events like the Asian Para Games in Japan and the 2026 Los Angeles Paralympics.

recent_articles.title: Bid to ‘sell’ train seat: Surat court reduces railway porter’s jail term from 1 month to 2 days | Ahmedabad News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An additional sessions court in Surat reduced the jail sentence of Raghu Dayma, a railway porter convicted for illegally selling a train seat, from one month to two days. The court also increased the fine amount from Rs 500 to Rs 1,500.  The court's decision came after an appeal filed by Dayma, who was initially sentenced by the Judicial Magistrate First Class (Railways) court in Surat. **Kamal Saiyed**, a senior correspondent for The Indian Express, reported on the case and provided context about the court proceedings.

recent_articles.title: Why Congress Needs Overhaul In Punjab: Challenges Ahead Of 2027
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** secured a decisive victory in the Punjab local body elections, winning 958 seats and demonstrating strong dominance. The Congress party saw its seat count plummet from 1,399 to just 397, highlighting internal factionalism issues within the party. The **BJP** gained urban ground, increasing its seats from 49 to 172.  The Akali Dal also experienced a decline in its electoral performance.  The Congress High Command is preparing for significant changes within the Punjab unit, including potential replacements for the state president and leadership positions.

recent_articles.title: Which cancer screenings are actually recommended after 40?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. Tarang Krishna**, an oncologist, recommends regular medical tests for individuals over 40 to prevent cancer. However, **Dr. Arun Kumar Giri**, Director of Surgical Oncology at Aakash Healthcare, cautions against indiscriminate use of tumor markers like PSA and CA-19.9 as they can lead to false reassurance, unnecessary anxiety, and overdiagnosis.  He emphasizes that cancer screening should be based on age, symptoms, family history, and scientifically proven benefits, not fear.  An ideal health check-up focuses on sustainable wellness and early identification of chronic diseases.

recent_articles.title: Former ED special director Satyabrata Kumar who probed Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, takes VRS | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Satyabrata Kumar**, a former special director of the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)**, has opted for voluntary retirement from government service after nearly 12 years with the agency.  Kumar oversaw high-profile investigations including those involving Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, and the Mahadev online betting network. He received approval for voluntary retirement in April and his departure marks the second instance within a year of a senior ED officer leaving government service shortly after exiting the agency. The **ED** arrested Satinder Singh Bhasin, director of Bhasin Infotech and Infrastructure Pvt Ltd, on charges of money laundering related to alleged cheating of home buyers.

recent_articles.title: Despite social media build-up, Cockroach Janata Party meeting in Kochi fails to take place - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A planned meeting of the **Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)**, a digital political movement founded by Abhijeet Dipke, was canceled on Marine Drive in Kochi.  **City police** received information that the gathering was called off and the organizers were seeking permission before proceeding. The CJP aims to address social injustices and bring forth legal action against them, but its legitimacy remains unclear.

recent_articles.title: Tenant warned civic body, police months before deadly Delhi building collapse: AAP - Delhi News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A three-storey commercial building collapsed in Delhi's Mehrauli, killing at least six people. **AAP** leader Saurabh Bharadwaj alleged that the building had faced repeated complaints about unauthorized construction and safety concerns, but municipal authorities failed to act.  The **MCD**, which has suspended two engineers and registered an FIR against the building owner, is facing accusations of misleading the court and shielding the builder. The rescue operation is ongoing with teams using heavy machinery and sniffer dogs to search for survivors.

recent_articles.title: Just 2 weeks after launch, Ludhiana’s Halwara airport damaged during thunderstorm | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A severe thunderstorm and heavy rain caused structural damage to the newly operational Halwara civil terminal at Ludhiana airport on Saturday.  **Airport Director Jagir Singh** confirmed that no injuries occurred, but repairs are underway. **Ludhiana Deputy Commissioner Himanshu Jain** ordered an inquiry into the extent of the damage and mandated immediate repairs for passenger safety. The construction was completed by the **Punjab government’s Public Works Department (PWD)** after a private contractor abandoned the project midway.  Union Minister **Ravneet Singh Bittu** criticized the Punjab AAP government's handling of the situation.

recent_articles.title: From corridors of power: Sunil Jakhar’s tragedy, CM Mann’s walk that never was and Rahul Gandhi’s ‘third warning’ | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunil Jakhar**, a prominent figure in Punjab politics, has faced repeated setbacks as he continues to be passed over for leadership positions.  **Rahul Gandhi** delivered a "third warning" to **Punjab Congress** leaders regarding their performance in the recent municipal elections, which saw significant losses. Meanwhile, **CM Bhagwant Mann's** planned early-morning walk with morning walkers was canceled at the last minute. The relationship between former Chief Minister **Captain Amarinder Singh** and newly appointed **BJP** chief **Kewal Dhillon** has been strained by **Amarinder's** public criticism of **Dhillon's** appointment.

recent_articles.title: Thousands without power in Perth as destructive storms hit WA | Australia news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Western Australia** experienced intense storms with powerful winds and heavy rain, causing widespread damage. **The Department of Fire and Emergency Services** issued an alert urging residents to stay safe due to damaging winds that could bring down trees and powerlines.  **Western Power** reported 14,600 customers affected by outages in the state. The storm also brought high tides and eight-meter waves, flooding parts of Perth's CBD.  The **Bureau of Meteorology** advised residents to secure loose items and stay indoors during the severe weather event.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee attack: Can Mamata Banerjee rebuild INDIA bloc after TMC poll rout? - India Today

recent_articles.title: Dimpy Dhillon of AAP gets third-time lucky - The Tribune

recent_articles.title: Akshita Nandagopal

recent_articles.title: Punjab civic polls results: AAP sweeps elections, BJP and Congress win key corporations - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** swept the Punjab civic body polls, winning 958 of 1,977 municipal wards. However, political analysts cautioned against directly linking the civic poll outcome to the 2027 Assembly polls. Opposition parties accused the AAP government of using official machinery to influence the election.

recent_articles.title: The political economy of cash transfers
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** budgetary allocation for unconditional cash transfers (UCT) has increased significantly, reaching 0.9% of GDP in 2026.  While **Government of India** officials and researchers warn that this expansion will increase future debt burdens and crowd out productive investment, the practice persists due to political incentives. The rise of UCT is driven by voter-targeted cash transfers, which have become a popular strategy for election campaigns. This trend has led to increased competition among parties, with promises of cash transfers becoming a key electoral tool.  However, critics argue that poorly designed UCT schemes fail to create long-term productive assets and can negatively impact fiscal sustainability.

recent_articles.title: ‘Claims of vishwaguru but...’: Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal hit out at PM Modi over CUET-UG exam 2026 delay | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Atishi**, and other Opposition leaders criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's handling of the Common University Entrance Test (CUET-UG) 2026 after technical glitches caused disruptions at several examination centers across India.  The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** confirmed that a technical glitch by its service provider, **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** delayed the commencement of the exam on May 30th. The agency revised the afternoon shift schedule and provided full duration to morning-session candidates.

recent_articles.title: People defeated opposition’s politics of hatred: Punjab CM Mann on civic poll outcome - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** has won over 860 of the 1,977 wards in Punjab's civic body elections, leading in many others.  **Bhagwant Mann**, Punjab Chief Minister, expressed satisfaction with the results, attributing the victory to the people rejecting "opposition's politics of hatred" and supporting AAP's development agenda. The party secured a significant win despite facing opposition from **BJP**, **Congress**, and **SAD**.

recent_articles.title: New Punjab BJP chief Kewal Dhillon won’t be able to deliver: Capt Amarinder - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Capt Amarinder Singh**, former Punjab Chief Minister, criticized the appointment of **Kewal Dhillon** as the new BJP state chief, arguing that organizational capability should have been prioritized over caste considerations. recent_articles.title: Aam Aadmi Party scores big in Punjab civic elections - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** secured a resounding victory in Punjab's urban local body elections, winning control of five municipal corporations and nine nagar panchayats.  **Bhagwant Mann**, the Chief Minister, hailed the outcome as "historic" and attributed it to AAP's model of good governance. The Congress finished second, while Independents secured third place.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee heckled | TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee allegedly manhandled by agitating locals at Sonarpur in Bengal's South 24 Parganas: Police - Telegraph India

Opposition leaders across parties, including **Samik Bhattacharya** (BJP), **Mallikarjun Kharge** (Congress), **Akhilesh Yadav** (SP), **Arvind Kejriwal** (AAP), and **Tejashwi Yadav** (RJD), condemned the attack on Banerjee and called for an end to political violence.

recent_articles.title: Eye on poll, BJP picks Kewal Singh Dhillon as first Jat Sikh Punjab unit chief - The Tribune

Dhillon, a Jat Sikh leader with experience in both Congress and BJP, is expected to focus on farmers' welfare and ensure minimum support price (MSP) for crops. **The BJP** hopes Dhillon will help them gain power in the 2027 Assembly elections. While **Sunil Jakhar**, who previously held the position, has not been assigned a new role yet, sources suggest he will remain influential in the party's Punjab campaign.

recent_articles.title: Kejriwal's Claims Of IB Threats Backfire; Call Traced Back To AAP Leader | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** and its leader **Arvind Kejriwal** faced embarrassment after allegations of threats by the **Intelligence Bureau (IB)** and police backfired.  **Gujarat Police** arrested two men, including the party's Vadodara city unit president, for allegedly making a "threat call" to an AAP worker posing as an IB official. The investigation stemmed from a social media post by **Kejriwal**, who questioned the harassment of workers in Gujarat. The phone number linked to the alleged threat was traced back to **Nitin Dobriya**, a labor contractor, and his actions were allegedly orchestrated by **Ashok Oza**, the Vadodara unit president.  **Gadhvi**, the Gujarat AAP president, expressed shock at the incident and stated that the party will take appropriate action if connections or responsibilities emerge in Gujarat.

recent_articles.title: Modi charisma key factor in BJP's bid to retain all 26 seats in Gujarat - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The upcoming Lok Sabha elections in Gujarat are expected to be influenced by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** charisma, as he is a prominent figure for the state.  Anti-incumbency sentiment, unemployment, inflation, education and healthcare facilities are also key issues that will shape voter decisions. The ruling BJP aims to retain all 26 seats it won in 2019. The opposition parties will likely capitalize on these concerns to challenge the incumbent government. Gujarat is a crucial state for determining the outcome of the Lok Sabha elections.

recent_articles.title: BJP accuses Kejriwal of sending voters hoax calls to mislead - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** accused **Arvind Kejriwal**, leader of the **AAP**, of orchestrating hoax calls to mislead voters and distribute money in slum areas.  **Parvesh Verma**, a BJP MP, played an audio recording of one such call, alleging that the **AAP** is attempting to manipulate voters. The **BJP** demanded an investigation into these allegations.

recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Revival In Bengal? Support For Mamata Banerjee Over Nephew's Assault

The incident has led to calls for stronger law-and-order measures in West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: Punjab civic polls: Early edge to Congress as counting proceeds amid tight security - India Today

recent_articles.title: How Municipal Poll Setback Brought Congress Factionalism To Fore In Punjab

While the high command has stated there will be no immediate organizational changes, factionalism remains a significant challenge for the party as it seeks to address accountability and build unity for future electoral success.

recent_articles.title: Delhi HC refuses to immediately restore Cockroach Janta Party’s X account in India - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Delhi High Court** declined immediate relief to **Abhijeet Dipke**, founder of the satirical group **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)**, whose X handle was blocked on national security grounds.  **Dipke** has been directed to approach a review committee under the IT Rule after the original handle was withheld on May 21. The court issued notice to the **Centre**.

recent_articles.title: Flooding rains expected across three Australian states as parched interior receives drenching | Australia weather | The Guardian

Rainfall totals have been significant across the region, with some areas experiencing over 100mm in just 24 hours.

recent_articles.title: ED raids Pinarayi Vijayan's residences in CMRL-Exalogic case - The Hindu

Veena, in Kannur and Thiruvananthapuram, alleging that her defunct firm received substantial monthly retainers from **Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited (CMRL)** between 2017 and 2021 without rendering any tangible service. recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha defections, constitutional questions - The Hindu

This event, occurring at the national level in the Rajya Sabha, carries significant political consequences.

recent_articles.title: I don’t think the ruling party has the stomach for sarcasm, says Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janta Party** (CJP), a youth-led satirical political group, had its website taken down on Saturday, May 23, 2026 at 9 a.m.  Founder Abhijeet Dipke accused the **Indian Government** of orchestrating the takedown, claiming it was due to the CJP's growing popularity and online movement demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan following the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak. recent_articles.title: Delhi HC seeks response from AAP’s Gopal Rai, journalist in contempt plea - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Three die in ‘horrific’ south Sydney vehicle crash after police welfare check | Sydney | The Guardian

Police believe the Audi was traveling at "considerable speed" when the crash occurred. Investigations are continuing into the circumstances surrounding the incident.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan gets its own ‘Cockroach Awaam Party’ as India’s viral CJP sparks cross-border satire wave - The Times of India

recent_articles.title: Four-year-old boy rescued after falling into borewell in Punjab’s Hoshiarpur - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: AAP, Congress raises concern over SIR in Punjab ahead of 2027 Assembly polls - The Hindu
